description: This file defines a React component for a tree view UI, including types, rendering logic, and tree indexing functions.

classes.name: TreeItem
classes.description: Type representing a tree node with id, parent, and children.

classes.name: TreeState
classes.description: Type representing the state of expanded items in the tree.

classes.name: TreeViewProps
classes.description: Type for the props accepted by the TreeView React component, generic over T.

classes.name: TreeItemHeader
classes.description: React component for rendering individual tree items with expand/collapse and selection.

classes.name: TreeItemData
classes.description: Type for indexing information about each tree node during tree traversal.

methods.name: TreeView
methods.description: Main React component rendering the entire tree view, managing state, keyboard navigation, and scrolling.

methods.name: TreeItemHeader
methods.description: Component rendering a single tree node, handling user interactions and recursive rendering of children.

methods.name: indexTree
methods.description: Function to index the tree structure for efficient navigation and rendering, considering visibility and auto-expansion.
